newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-FREE STATE WIN TOSS, PUT W.P. IN TO BAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-FREE STATE WIN TOSS, PUT W.P. IN TO BAT.

text.p: Free State captain Louis Wilkinson won the toss and put Western Province into bat on the opening day their four-day match at Springbok Park on Friday.

Free State: Louis Wilkinson (captain), Deon Jordaan, Boeta Dippenaar, Gerhardus Liebenberg, Kosie Venter, Franklyn Stephenson, Bradley Player, Phillip Radley, Herman Bakkes, Sarel Cilliers, Henk Botha.
Western Province: Desmond Haynes, Sven Koenig, Jacques Kallis, HD Ackerman, Faiek Davids, Eric Simons (captain), Alan Dawson, Dave Rundle, Paul Kirsten, Meyrick Pringle, Aubrey Martyn.
